_comment: Per-trail settings for tools/build_map_geojson.py. gpxUrl is the official GPX from the trail's 'Trail information & map' page on nationaltrail.co.uk. mainTracks lists the GPX track names that make up the main route, in walking order of the source file; every other track is reported and left out. officialMiles is only used for the comparison in the report. osmRelation (optional) is the OpenStreetMap route relation for the main route; find it at https://hiking.waymarkedtrails.org (search the trail name). Use the child route, not a 'superroute'.
